name: step-indicator
title: Step Indicator
description: A vertical step indicator with a continuous 18px-wide rail, per-step icons, status-aware fill, and a right-side completion adornment (green check / progress ring / empty circle). Composes ProgressCircle for active steps. Uses namespace exports: StepIndicator.Root, StepIndicator.Item, StepIndicator.Composed.

docs.lead: A vertical step indicator that shows progress through a multi-step flow. The rail is an 18px-wide capsule that fills from the top down to the last non-pending step, with rounded caps at both ends and at every filled→unfilled transition. Each row shows a status-aware right-side indicator: success check, progress ring, or empty circle.
docs.usage:
import * as StepIndicator from "@/components/ui/step-indicator"
import { RiUser3Fill, RiMoneyDollarCircleFill } from "@remixicon/react"

<StepIndicator.Root>
  <StepIndicator.Item
    status="completed"
    icon={RiUser3Fill}
    title="Capability & Fit"
    description="3 Questions"
  />
  <StepIndicator.Item
    status="active"
    progress={50}
    icon={RiMoneyDollarCircleFill}
    title="Offer Details"
    description="3 Questions"
  />
</StepIndicator.Root>

examples.title: First Step Active
examples.description: The flow has just started — only the first step is active, the rest are pending. The rail shows a small filled cap at the top with rounded ends.
examples.code:
<StepIndicator.Composed
  items={[
    { status: 'active', progress: 30, icon: RiUser3Fill, title: 'Capability & Fit', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'pending', icon: RiMoneyDollarCircleFill, title: 'Offer Details', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'pending', icon: RiQuestionFill, title: 'Financing & Readiness', description: '4 Questions' },
    { status: 'pending', icon: RiFileFill, title: 'Supporting Documents', description: '2 Questions' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Mid Progress
examples.description: First step completed, second step active. The filled rail extends from the top through the active step and ends with a rounded cap; the gray track resumes below with a rounded top.
examples.code:
<StepIndicator.Composed
  items={[
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiUser3Fill, title: 'Capability & Fit', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'active', progress: 50, icon: RiMoneyDollarCircleFill, title: 'Offer Details', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'pending', icon: RiQuestionFill, title: 'Financing & Readiness', description: '4 Questions' },
    { status: 'pending', icon: RiFileFill, title: 'Supporting Documents', description: '2 Questions' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Last Step Active
examples.description: Most steps completed, the final step is active. The rail extends through every position and the last step shows a progress ring on the right.
examples.code:
<StepIndicator.Composed
  items={[
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiUser3Fill, title: 'Capability & Fit', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiMoneyDollarCircleFill, title: 'Offer Details', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiQuestionFill, title: 'Financing & Readiness', description: '4 Questions' },
    { status: 'active', progress: 70, icon: RiFileFill, title: 'Supporting Documents', description: '2 Questions' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: All Completed
examples.description: Every step is done — the rail is fully filled and every right-side adornment shows the success check.
examples.code:
<StepIndicator.Composed
  items={[
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiUser3Fill, title: 'Capability & Fit', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiMoneyDollarCircleFill, title: 'Offer Details', description: '3 Questions' },
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiQuestionFill, title: 'Financing & Readiness', description: '4 Questions' },
    { status: 'completed', icon: RiFileFill, title: 'Supporting Documents', description: '2 Questions' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Compound API
examples.description: Use Root + Item directly for full control over each row (e.g., individual click handlers, per-row classes).
examples.code:
<StepIndicator.Root>
  <StepIndicator.Item status="completed" icon={RiUser3Fill} title="Capability & Fit" description="3 Questions" />
  <StepIndicator.Item status="active" progress={50} icon={RiMoneyDollarCircleFill} title="Offer Details" description="3 Questions" />
  <StepIndicator.Item status="pending" icon={RiQuestionFill} title="Financing & Readiness" description="4 Questions" />
  <StepIndicator.Item status="pending" icon={RiFileFill} title="Supporting Documents" description="2 Questions" />
</StepIndicator.Root>

examples.title: Custom Rail Colors
examples.description: Override the filled and unfilled rail Tailwind classes via railFilledClassName and railTrackClassName to retheme the indicator.

api.name: StepIndicator.Root
api.description: Container that computes rail-fill state from its Item children and threads it down via cloneElement. Forwards a ref to the underlying div and accepts standard div props.

props.name: railFilledClassName
props.description: Tailwind class for the filled rail and the icon bulge of non-pending steps. Override to retheme.

props.name: railTrackClassName
props.description: Tailwind class for the unfilled rail track and pending icon bulges.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names. Default is `flex w-full flex-col` (no gap — gaps are inside each Item so the rail reads as one continuous capsule).

api.name: StepIndicator.Item
api.description: A single row in the indicator. Reads its position from Root via cloneElement-injected props to render the correct rail-fill state. Must be a direct child of Root (or rendered via Composed).

props.name: status
props.description: Drives the rail bulge color, the right-side adornment, and the rail-fill computation in Root.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component (e.g. from @remixicon/react) rendered inside the rail bulge at 12px. Required.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary label shown in the content column.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the title (e.g. '3 Questions', a date, or a hint).

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress 0–100 used by the right-side ProgressCircle when status is 'active'. Ignored otherwise.

api.name: StepIndicator.Composed
api.description: Data-driven shorthand that renders Root + Item from an items array. Accepts all Root props plus an `items` array.

props.name: items
props.type: { status: 'pending' | 'active' | 'completed'; icon: React.ElementType; title: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; progress?: number; onClick?: (e: MouseEvent) => void }[]
props.description: Array of step definitions, rendered in order.
